cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Help Me Make This Normal
cards.instruction: Get someone to help perform the strange behavior until it feels ordinary.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Our invisible dinner guest is here. Will you introduce Mum while I finish the gravy?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can't see where to look.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. The chair beside you. Just introduce them as you normally would.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Hello, chair, this is Mum. She needs your seat.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Introduce her to the guest, love. Then fetch another chair; we can't ask someone to stand just because Mum can't see them.

mechanism: A corrects its pupil introductions and seating etiquette to make invisible-guest hospitality a shared ordinary task.
confusable: Not merely announcing an invisible person: B must introduce and make room, with the odd premise accommodated through learned manners.
comparison: Practical serving adaptation versus personal introduction and extra chair.
seedUse: D145 invisible guest/Mum/gravy/chair; S05 old introduction practice.
